patterns: Builder-of-monument is the commonest shape: Khajuraho/Kandariya Mahadeva = Chandelas, Modhera Sun temple (Gujarat), Vijaya Stambha = Rana Kumbha (APPSC G2 2011).
Author-of-raso items recur: Prithviraj Raso = Chand Bardai (APPSC 2018), Alha Khand = Jagnik, Bisaldeva Raso = Narapati Nalha, Prithviraja Vijaya = Jayanaka.
Solanki rulers: Hemachandra at Kumarapala's court, Kumarapala's ban on animal slaughter, Siddharaja's Khambhat mosque grant.
Trap: some PSC keys call Kumbha's victory tower 'Kirti Stambha' (y9d86769084d); the Jain Kirti Stambha (Jijaji, 12th c.) is a different tower.
APPSC asks single-line items (Rajput warfare = personal valour); app adds long statement sets and Bhojshala/Modhera current affairs.
